package rulefixtures

// scenario for go_perf_layer_async_concurrency_channel_buffer_too_small_for_known_burst: Layer: Async and concurrency. Flag channels created with no or tiny buffer despite a known burst size.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func scenario504Positive(producerCount int) chan int {
	ch := make(chan int)
	for i := 0; i < producerCount; i++ {
		go func(id int) {
			ch <- id
		}(i)
	}
	return ch
}
